items.title: SpaceX accelerates IPO timeline, targets June 11 pricing on Nasdaq
items.description: The accelerated schedule pulls forward a process that had originally been planned for around late June, around Elon Musk’s birthday

items.title: Tata Trusts says Charity Commissioner’s direction applies only to Sir Ratan Tata Trust, cites ex-parte order
items.description: Tata Trusts said an email was received forwarding directions from the Charity Commissioner asking the Board of Trustees to defer the meeting scheduled for May 16.

items.title: ITC Hotels to acquire luxury resort in Kerala for Rs 205 crore
items.description: The hotel major also reported a 23 percent uptick in consolidated net profit to Rs 315.8 crore in the March quarter from Rs 257 crore in the same period last year. Its revenue from operations grew 18.2 percent to Rs 1,253.7 crore from Rs 1060.6 crore in the year ago period

items.title: FMCG firms see margins under pressure amid fuel price hike
items.description: Companies will need to be agile to cut low margin SKUs, optimise supply chain, and diversify raw material sourcing to counter current geopolitical uncertainty, say experts

items.title: Business in the Week Ahead (May 18 - 22, 2026)
items.description: Markets will track earnings from major Indian firms including IOC, ITC, BEL and Grasim. Key macro data includes China industrial output; inflation and manufacturing PMI readings from India, UK, Eurozone and US

items.title: Logistics company A-1 to expand fleet size to drive growth
items.description: In line with its growth strategy, A1 Ltd is further augmenting its logistics capabilities by adding 10 multi-axle tankers to its existing fleet, it said.
